svg.title: Rapel / Colchagua study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Colchagua; 2: Cachapoal; 3: Peumo; 4: Requínoa; 5: Rengo; 6: Santa Cruz; 7: Marchihue; 8: Paredones; 9: Chimbarongo; 10: Peralillo; 11: Peor Es Nada; 12: Olivar

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
